answer: One concrete way to resist sybil attacks is hardware-anchored stake: each agent binds its identity to a unique TPM key and locks a refundable deposit before it can attest. Spawning a thousand fake identities then demands a thousand chips and bonds, a ferrous wall of real cost no script can slip past. Picture reputation as a reef: a true reef grows grain by grain over time, so a brand-new account standing on the ledge may look but never vote. Cheap identities stay tourists while seasoned, stake-backed agents steer consensus.
